description: This file defines classes and methods for reading entire files as streams or byte arrays within Apache Spark, specifically handling PortableDataStream objects. It includes abstract classes for input formats and record readers, as well as a serializable wrapper for data streams.

classes.name: StreamFileInputFormat
classes.description: Abstract class for input formats that read entire files as streams or byte arrays.

classes.name: StreamBasedRecordReader
classes.description: Abstract class for record readers that process files as streams.

classes.name: StreamRecordReader
classes.description: Concrete record reader that returns PortableDataStream objects.

classes.name: StreamInputFormat
classes.description: Input format class for PortableDataStream files.

classes.name: PortableDataStream
classes.description: Serializable class that encapsulates a data stream, allowing delayed creation and movement across nodes.

methods.name: setMinPartitions
methods.description: Sets minimum number of partitions for input splitting based on configuration and file sizes.

methods.name: createRecordReader
methods.description: Creates a record reader for input splits.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns progress of reading as a float.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Returns the current value (stream or data).

methods.name: nextKeyValue
methods.description: Advances to the next key-value pair, reading the file stream.

methods.name: parseStream
methods.description: Abstract method to parse a stream into type T.

methods.name: parseStream
methods.description: Returns the input stream as PortableDataStream.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Creates a DataInputStream for the file.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Reads entire file into a byte array.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the file path as string.
